steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation required by the case.
Allow adding the vendor during event creation.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Create the Technical plus RFQ stage combination.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
rfp needs its own template
Add the required product line item.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
rfq needs its own template
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Invite one QA vendor as Vendor A.
Publish the configured two-stage event.
Verify that publication succeeded.
Open the invited vendor's separate supplier session.
Open the event's Technical stage in the vendor portal.
Verify the first Technical-stage clause is shown to the vendor.
Verify the second Technical-stage clause is shown to the vendor.
Accept only one of the two mandatory clauses.
Verify submission is blocked while the second mandatory clause remains unaccepted.
Open the RFQ pricing stage to check stage-specific term visibility.
Verify the Technical-only clause is not shown on the RFQ stage.
Verify the second Technical-only clause is not shown on the RFQ stage.
